installation_contract.validation: official controller and independently authenticated backend adapter

optional.timezone: project calendar timezone, defaults to UTC
optional.adoption_checkpoint: Absolute reference to the already mapped owned JSON checkpoint. The controller never advances adoption.

instruction_sources.organization: Scoped operations layer locator or explicit null
instruction_sources.workspace: Scoped common private layer locator or explicit null

registration.authority: The installation owns the root declarative adapter and registration and independently observes machine-local storage. Event data cannot choose the project, checkout, source or registration.

output.native: Documented host context channel with nonblocking success disposition.
output.assurance: Context only. Independent host authorization, actual capability and effect observation govern work.

adapter.input: bounded UTF-8 JSON on standard input
adapter.record_exit: 0 only for an explicit accepted receipt; otherwise 1. Inspect correlation.
adapter.implementation: Fixed declarative scaffold; controller-owned loading, dispatch and native rendering.

errors.acknowledgement: Exact owned unread UID array, actual presentation and current turn/version; atomic idempotent receipt stored with flags. Read means consumed, never resolved.
errors.recovery: Read current diagnostic receipts before retry; exact retained request replays without mutation, changed payload conflicts. Journal revision and receipts represent turn diagnostic state independently of classification version.
errors.limits: No raw prompts/secrets/stacks; serialized bounded atomic journal, no unread eviction. Corruption, full storage and unknown root remain explicit failures.

submission.accepted: context.status=record_accepted and correlated context.receipt.disposition=accepted; first version=expected_version+1
submission.duplicate: Same retained request_id and identical payload reuses its receipt within the same turn; different payload is correlation_conflict.
submission.recovery: Snapshot reads current state and bounded receipts without advancing a turn or synchronization. Resolve uncertain outcome before retry; missing expired receipt is not failure proof.
submission.timing: Each new subject, including G0, before substantive response or dependent effects; reclassify scope changes and record applicable transitions. Continuation reuses subject, with current turn/version.
submission.authority: Attributed technical claims only; no effect permission, artificial G0 ticket or raw prompt persistence.

daily.trigger: first supported session opening or prompt outside bootstrap
daily.migration: Deliver the synchronized target and lifecycle and migration locators to the runtime. The runtime executes applicable procedures under existing authority and retains its separately verified adoption checkpoint.

history.data: Turn, procedure state, governance level, ticket relation and bounded canonical routing facets. Raw prompt, transcript and credentials are excluded.
history.stale_writer: Turn and version must match before a reachable subject state update; exact retained replay never advances state.

delivery: Abstract interoperable contract; native/local interfaces suffice. No mandatory interpreter product, integration protocol, policy engine or hosted service.

evidence.authority: A supplied fact requires independent attributable scope-bound evidence; shape or a true boolean is not proof.

checkpoints.cardinality: One authoritative logical current adoption checkpoint per initialized workspace/persistent-runtime key; zero before initialization, no competing current authority.
checkpoints.discovery: Resolve authorized topology mapping before adoption discovery or creation; unknown ownership blocks dependent scope, never creates a session-derived fallback.
checkpoints.write: Use applicable expected-revision/concurrency and atomic persistence; atomic rename alone does not prevent lost updates.
checkpoints.reuse: Require exact relevant dependencies and current ownership/freshness; workspace switch invalidates active project state.
